add.title: TaskView.row: give each verb button a fixed slot so the controls line up down a list
add.why: A row shows only the verbs its state allows (idle: start and stop; waiting: stop and approve), so the stop button sits in column 2 on one row and column 1 on the next, which looks ragged at 1920 (session-is-a-task review, finding 10, on the session page's feed).
